## We are here for you! Have a cash need or are looking for a deal?

We have all the cash you need. Obtaining a loan on one item or several items is fast and easy. Items
are evaluated and appraised at the store.

Need a smart TV, tablet or camera? What about a high-end handbag or quality watch for a fraction of
the retail price? Our stores have a variety of items and part of the fun is the treasure hunt. Come
see us!

Contact your local store to get a loan estimate for your item before visiting the store!

[Find a location][21]

## Look up your loan? Can’t make it into the store on time? EZ+ can help.

EZ+ is a digital app to manage your pawn loans on your smartphone. With the EZ+ app, you can extend
your loan (where available) and manage payments, all in the palm of your hand.

[View My Loans Online][22]

## Layaway for the Holidays!

Get ahead of the holiday rush and lock in the gifts they’ll love. With our Layaway program, you can
shop early and spread your payments over time, no credit needed. From pre-loved jewelry, tech,
shoes, handbags, and more, you'll find incredible deals on unique gifts at prices that fit your
budget. Start your holiday shopping today and enjoy the flexibility to pay over time while reserving
the items you want before the holiday season begins.

[Find a Location][23]

## Frequently Asked Questions

Can I claim my remittance in Cebuana Lhuillier

If the sending agent is one of the international tie-up partners of Cebuana Lhuillier, clients may
claim their money at any branch. Click [here][128] for the complete list of remittance partners.

How do I send money (domestic)
* Visit any Cebuana Lhuillier branch and fill out the Pera Padala form.
* Present the accomplished form, valid ID, and 24k card (if you are a 24k cardholder) to the branch
  personnel.
* Give the total amount to be paid.
* Secure the Pera Padala form (and count the change received, if there is any).
* Provide the 10-digit control number to the receiver/beneficiary.
How do I know the service fee for sending money

Rates vary. Please click [here][129] for Pera Padala rates and charges.

Can I authorize someone else to claim my money?

No, If the receiver or beneficiary is not available to claim the money, they may advise the sender
to amend the receiver’s name.

Can I cancel or refund my remittance?

The sender may cancel or refund their remittance. The sender needs to visit the branch where the
transaction was processed. Please be reminded that the service fee is non-refunda

Can I change the receiver’s name? How?

The sender may visit any branch of Cebuana Lhuillier to change the receiver’s name. The sender needs
to bring the Pera Padala form and present a valid ID. There is an amendment fee of Php10.

Can I change the receiver’s name? How?

What are the acceptable IDs when pawning?

As required by BSP, Clients who engage in a financial transaction with covered institutions for the
first time shall be required to present the original and submit a clear copy of at least ONE (1)
valid photo-bearing identification document issued by an official authority. For our clients’
convenience, Cebuana no longer requires submission of the photocopied ID. IDs are captured using a
webcam in all branches. Clients are also required to submit an updated photo and other relevant
information whenever the need for it arises.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Can I claim my remittance in Cebuana Lhuillier

If the sending agent is one of the international tie-up partners of Cebuana Lhuillier, clients may
claim their money at any branch. Click [here][128] for the complete list of remittance partners.

How do I send money (domestic)
* Visit any Cebuana Lhuillier branch and fill out the Pera Padala form.
* Present the accomplished form, valid ID, and 24k card (if you are a 24k cardholder) to the branch
  personnel.
* Give the total amount to be paid.
* Secure the Pera Padala form (and count the change received, if there is any).
* Provide the 10-digit control number to the receiver/beneficiary.
How do I know the service fee for sending money

Rates vary. Please click [here][129] for Pera Padala rates and charges.

Can I authorize someone else to claim my money?

No, If the receiver or beneficiary is not available to claim the money, they may advise the sender
to amend the receiver’s name.

Can I cancel or refund my remittance?

The sender may cancel or refund their remittance. The sender needs to visit the branch where the
transaction was processed. Please be reminded that the service fee is non-refunda

Can I change the receiver’s name? How?

The sender may visit any branch of Cebuana Lhuillier to change the receiver’s name. The sender needs
to bring the Pera Padala form and present a valid ID. There is an amendment fee of Php10.

What are the acceptable IDs when pawning?

As required by BSP, Clients who engage in a financial transaction with covered institutions for the
first time shall be required to present the original and submit a clear copy of at least ONE (1)
valid photo-bearing identification document issued by an official authority. For our clients’
convenience, Cebuana no longer requires submission of the photocopied ID. IDs are captured using a
webcam in all branches. Clients are also required to submit an updated photo and other relevant
information whenever the need for it arises.

answers while organizing topics into clear categories for easy exploration.

Q. What is CGAA?

A. CGAA is a directory driven by a community of experts. We find answers to the commonly asked
questions on the internet. In collaboration with our users, we identify unanswered questions,
helping people find the information they need.

Q. What topics does CGAA cover?

A. Our topics include working conditions, the new york times, credit bureau, economic policy, and
social programs. We are constantly expanding our selection. Have an idea for a category? Please
[contact us][60].

Q. Who is this for?

A. CGAA is a free tool for curious minds and anyone seeking knowledge.

Q. Can I advertise on CGAA?

A. As a directory driven by a community of experts, we welcome advertisers who can enhance the
experience for our users. If you're interested in featuring your brand in a CGAA article, please
[reach out][61] to our team.

the organisation caters to the diverse needs of its business customers and continuously work towards
always upholding their motto of being ‘Your Trusted Partner’.

## Часто задаваемые вопросы

Чем ломбард отличается от банка или микрозайма?
Ключевое отличие — залог. В ломбарде вы получаете деньги под залог вашей вещи (украшения, техника и
т.д.). Банк или МФО выдают кредит на основе вашей кредитной истории и справок о доходах. В ломбарде
не проверяют кредитную историю, решение принимается за 5-15 минут на основе оценки вещи. Если вы не
выкупите залог, ломбард продаст его, и на этом ваши обязательства заканчиваются — никаких
коллекторов и судов за долги.

## Часто задаваемые вопросы

Чем ломбард отличается от банка или микрозайма?
Ключевое отличие — залог. В ломбарде вы получаете деньги под залог вашей вещи (украшения, техника и
т.д.). Банк или МФО выдают кредит на основе вашей кредитной истории и справок о доходах. В ломбарде
не проверяют кредитную историю, решение принимается за 5-15 минут на основе оценки вещи. Если вы не
выкупите залог, ломбард продаст его, и на этом ваши обязательства заканчиваются — никаких
коллекторов и судов за долги.

## Maxferd’s History and Legacy

Maxferd Jewelry & Loan is the oldest pawnshop in the United States, beginning its journey in 1884 as
“Maxferd Loan Office” near Market Street in downtown San Francisco. 

Maxferd has a rich history as a pawnbroker, providing loans and pawning services to the community
for over 135 years. The company prides itself on offering high-end, vintage, and fine art
merchandise, including jewelry, precious metals, coins, gemstones, and diamonds, among other items.
Maxferd is also licensed and experienced in collateral loans, personal loans, title loans, and
lending money at competitive interest rates. The company’s extensive inventory, which includes a
wide range of collectibles, ensures that customers can find exactly what they are looking for, while
also saving money.

## More Than Just a Pawn Shop

Maxferd Jewelry & Loan is more than just a pawnshop – it is a part of America’s rich history and a
trusted lender that has been providing financial solutions to its community for generations.

Maxferd Jewelry and Loan has been providing individuals with quick and confidential cash loans for
over 135 years. Our pawnshop has a vast selection of collateral options, including fine jewelry,
high-end watches, and valuable collectibles, with some of the lowest interest rates in America.

At Maxferd, we understand that sometimes people need a little extra time to pay off their loans,
which is why we offer a 4-month loan term on all items pawned with us. This loan term can be
extended at any time to give you the flexibility you need. Additionally, for those pawning jewelry
items worth less than $2500, we provide the option to “Rollover” the loan, extending the loan term
by an additional 4 months without incurring any interest or principal payments. With this option,
our customers can enjoy up to 8 months without making a payment.

Common Questions

## FAQ

Is it free to submit my item?

Yes, completely free. YouPawn never charges borrowers to submit items or receive offers. We're
funded by pawn shops who pay to be listed in our directory.

Do I have to ship my item anywhere?

No. YouPawn is a local connection platform. After receiving offers, you bring your item to the
chosen pawn shop in person. Your item never leaves your hands until you've agreed to terms.

Will this affect my credit score?

Pawn loans are collateral-based and do not involve a credit check. Your credit score is not impacted
when you submit an item, receive offers, or take out a pawn loan.

How long do I have to repay the loan?

Loan terms are set by each individual pawn shop and vary by state law. Typical terms range from 30
to 90 days, often with extensions available. Always confirm terms directly with your chosen shop.

Are the pawn shops on YouPawn verified?

Yes. All shops in our directory are licensed and verified. We check state licensing records and
require shops to maintain good standing to remain listed on our platform.

Common Questions

## FAQ

Is it free to submit my item?

Yes, completely free. YouPawn never charges borrowers to submit items or receive offers. We're
funded by pawn shops who pay to be listed in our directory.

Do I have to ship my item anywhere?

No. YouPawn is a local connection platform. After receiving offers, you bring your item to the
chosen pawn shop in person. Your item never leaves your hands until you've agreed to terms.

Will this affect my credit score?

Pawn loans are collateral-based and do not involve a credit check. Your credit score is not impacted
when you submit an item, receive offers, or take out a pawn loan.

How long do I have to repay the loan?

Loan terms are set by each individual pawn shop and vary by state law. Typical terms range from 30
to 90 days, often with extensions available. Always confirm terms directly with your chosen shop.

Are the pawn shops on YouPawn verified?

Yes. All shops in our directory are licensed and verified. We check state licensing records and
require shops to maintain good standing to remain listed on our platform.
